title: Commands & Shortcuts selected-control routing contracts
description: CS-081 owns the typed Settings Commands & Shortcuts selected-control census: eight Commands-owned local owner actions (commands.create/update/delete/preview/import_preview/import_commit/export/reset_all) over route:settings/commands-shortcuts, settings.transaction bindings for Project-scoped shortcut/pref values, and view-only presentation rows. Fail-closed currentness, CS-033 validation, FileSafe containment with symlink guard, atomic write with durable readback, and root-bound file identity. Static contract only: no native runtime, EventRecord, storage-family, or readiness fact is proved.

command_name.description: Exact Commands_System.md section 2.5 name rule; matches the selected manager NAME_RE.

command_description.description: Required description, max 200 chars per section 6.1.3.

arguments_hint.description: GUI argumentsHint; binds losslessly to file arguments[0].hint per section 3.2.

command_scope.description: Command-file scope per section 2. Distinct from Project-only Settings scope.

anyOf.description: Global file under the single authorized root ~/.config/puppet-master/commands/.
Project file bound to the exact project id. Bare (scope,name) never identifies a project file.

root_fingerprint.description: Storage-owner logical_root_fingerprint, opaque to this census.

mode_value.description: Exact GUI Mode vocabulary. File form omits inherit per the section 3.2 mapping.

gui_overrides.description: GUI-shaped overrides; file mapping (persona_override/mode_override/model_override/permissions_profile_override) is owned by section 3.2 prose.

draft_content.description: GUI-shaped full command content. subtask/override_builtin have no selected control and round-trip preserved (false on create).

control_label.description: Exact hero-sheet field label that committed. (control_label, field) binding is a semantic check.

destination_target.description: Scope move destination; name equals source name and scope equals value; the two targets differ.

x-semantic-invariants: Scope moves bind independently current source and destination authorized roots; expected_root_* identifies source, expected_destination_root_* identifies destination.
destination_target.name == target.name; destination_target.scope == value; destination_target.scope != target.scope.
When either source or destination is project scoped, project_id is nonnull and resolves that exact current Project root.
A successful move result file_ref and root_* identify destination; moved_from identifies source. Both roots and absence are rechecked before promotion/unlink.

confirmation.description: Danger-modal proof. confirmed_name is the name the modal displayed; equality with target.name is a semantic check.

PreviewRequest.description: Side-effect-free read: no idempotency key, no list generation, no permission snapshot.

picked_file.description: Opaque OS-picker handle. Typed paths are never valid here.

ImportPreviewRequest.description: Plan-binding read: writes nothing, needs no idempotency key.

confirmation.description: Proof the reviewed plan was confirmed. Equality with plan_hash is a semantic check.

ExportRequest.description: Bounded manifest read: writes nothing, needs no idempotency key.

confirmation.description: Count confirmation. Equality with current counts is a semantic check.

ResetAllRequest.description: Composite reset requires project context: settings values are Project-bound.

updated_field.description: Null for create; the edited field for update.

moved_from.description: Source ref for Scope moves; null otherwise.

visible_scope.description: Section 2.3 resolution after the unlink: shadow reveal, unchanged shadow, or name removed.

preview_inert_ref.description: Inert placeholder: never read, never executed, never permission-evaluated.

preview_inert_injection.description: Inert shell placeholder: never executed, never permission-evaluated.

PreviewResult.description: Identical in viewer and writer modes: no degradation branch exists.

automatic_retry_permitted.description: Every census failure fails closed: no automatic retry, ever.

wrote.description: False for every pre-mutation rejection; true only for recovery_required after a failed rollback.

not.description: No route label may be a cmd.* token spelling: resurrection-proof by construction.

reviewed_import_plan.description: Immutable full F5 plan witness. plan_hash is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this exact object, including entry order and all content/absence/hash assertions. The small entries summary is display-only.

GenerationWitness.description: Static linked-fixture observation of the current owner projection immediately before the named dispatch; not a new command, persistence family, or client-carriable native authorization record.
